text: @codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level 是 DSH Web 界面的两级模型选择器，用户可先浏览供应商，再选择其模型。它替换输入区模型入口，使用宿主模型目录和会话选择服务，并提供跨供应商搜索及推理模型的思考强度选择。适合配置多个供应商、希望更清楚地查找和切换模型的 DSH 用户；使用宿主已有配置，不需额外 API Key。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level adds a two-level model picker to DSH Web. Browse providers, select a model, search across providers, and set reasoning effort when supported. It uses the host model directory and needs no extra API key.

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level 的「两级模型浏览」功能：点击输入区模型入口先查看供应商，再进入该供应商的模型列表并选择模型；列表显示当前选择和每家模型数量。
@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level 的「模型搜索与思考强度」功能：搜索可覆盖全部供应商或仅当前供应商，并支持按模型标识和名称匹配；支持推理的模型可选择思考强度，成功选择后在当前应用进程中记忆偏好。

section: 两级模型选择器 · DeepSeek Harness

text:
@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 是什么：配置多家模型供应商后，平铺的模型列表会变得很长。两级模型选择器将列表拆分为供应商页和模型页，先缩小范围，再选择目标模型；也可以直接搜索全部模型。

插件使用 Harness 已有的模型目录和会话选择能力，替换输入区的模型选择界面。供应商与模型仍由 Harness 配置和管理，内置的 /model 命令保持可用。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 功能：| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 两级导航 | 供应商页显示模型数量和当前使用标记，模型页只列出该家的模型 |
| 分层搜索 | 首页搜索全部供应商，模型页仅搜索本家；支持大小写无关和模糊匹配 |
| 思考强度 | 为支持推理的模型选择强度，并在当前应用进程内记忆成功选择的偏好 |
| 当前项提示 | 高亮当前供应商和模型，切换后同步更新输入区显示 |
| 键盘操作 | ↑↓ 移动，Enter 打开或确认，Esc 清空搜索、返回或关闭 |
| 界面适配 | 跟随宿主主题，窗口变化时重新定位，点击外部关闭 |
| 错误反馈 | 选择失败时保留菜单，目录不可用时提供诊断和重试入口 |

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 界面预览：| 供应商列表 | 模型列表 |
|---|---|
|  |  |

截图中的供应商和模型仅展示界面，实际列表以 Harness 中的配置为准。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 安装：通过 npm 安装：

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level
~~~

下载插件源码并进入项目目录后，执行：

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add .
~~~

也可以安装本地插件归档文件，将路径替换为实际下载的文件：

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./plugin.tgz
~~~

desktop 为 profile 示例，使用其他 profile 时替换名称。安装后重启整个 Harness。插件无需构建，本地安装不需要先安装开发依赖。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 卸载：~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level
~~~

卸载后重启 Harness，恢复宿主原有的模型选择器。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 使用方法：1. 点击输入区的模型按钮，查看供应商列表。
2. 选择供应商，进入该供应商的模型列表。单纯浏览不会改变当前模型。
3. 点击目标模型，成功后菜单关闭，输入区显示新选择。
4. 需要调整推理强度时，在供应商首页打开“思考强度”，选择可用档位。

首页搜索跨全部供应商；进入供应商后，搜索范围限定在本家。清空搜索会恢复当前页列表。供应商按宿主规则排列，账号和官方供应商优先，其余保持目录顺序；未搜索的模型保持目录顺序。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 键盘：| 按键 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| ↑ / ↓ | 移动列表高亮，不提交选择 |
| Enter | 在模型按钮上打开菜单；进入高亮供应商或确认模型 / 强度；按钮有焦点时激活该按钮 |
| Esc | 搜索有文字先清空；为空时返回供应商首页，首页则关闭 |
| 空格 | 搜索框中输入文字，不激活插件按钮 |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | 保留浏览器原有焦点行为，无插件自定义动作 |

输入法组字确认不会触发选择。更多操作见 [用户指南](docs/usage.md)。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 兼容性与运行环境：- DSH 运行时：当前声明支持 0.2.1-rc.3，可通过 dsh --version 查看。
- 界面：面向 Harness Web 界面，包括桌面客户端内的 Web 界面。
- 供应商：使用 Harness 已配置并提供到模型目录中的供应商和模型。
- 子代理会话：模型按钮禁用，不能从该入口切换。

其他运行时版本与平台的兼容性尚未声明。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 常见问题：**安装后为什么界面没有变化？**

重启整个 Harness，并确认插件安装到了当前使用的 profile。客户端模块没有热重载。

**是否需要重新配置供应商或 API Key？**

不需要。插件使用宿主已有目录，不提供凭证管理功能。

**思考强度会一直保存吗？**

偏好记忆仅在当前应用进程内有效，按供应商和模型共享。应用重启后，当前会话实际选择以宿主恢复的状态为准。

**切换失败后如何重试？**

菜单会保留错误信息。选择失败条中的“重试”只重载目录，再次提交需要重新选择目标项；目录不可用诊断面板的“重试”会重新解析目录服务。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 已知限制：- 无插件配置面板和打开 / 切层动画。
- 读屏对高亮项的宣布尚不完整。
- 尚无独立的刷新全部目录按钮，加载和缓存行为由宿主管理。
- 宿主升级可能影响兼容性，应以声明的运行时版本为准。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · 贡献与许可证：欢迎报告问题或提交改进，参与方式见 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

本项目使用 [MIT License](LICENSE)，是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的社区插件。

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Overview：A flat model list becomes harder to navigate as more providers are configured. This plugin separates provider browsing from model selection, so you can narrow the list first or search across all providers directly.

It replaces the model picker in the Harness composer while using the host's existing model directory and session-selection service. Providers and models remain managed by Harness, and the built-in /model command remains available.

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Features：| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Two-level navigation | Browse providers with model counts and a current-provider indicator, then view that provider's models |
| Scoped search | Search all providers from the home view or just one provider from its model view; matching is case-insensitive and supports fuzzy queries |
| Reasoning effort | Choose an available effort level for supported models and remember successful preferences within the running application |
| Current selection | Highlight the current provider and model and update the composer after a successful selection |
| Keyboard controls | Navigate with ↑↓, open or confirm with Enter, and clear search or go back with Esc |
| Host integration | Follow the host theme, reposition on window changes, and dismiss on outside clicks |
| Error feedback | Keep the menu open on selection failure and show diagnostics when the directory is unavailable |

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Preview：| Provider list | Model list |
|---|---|
|  |  |

The screenshots show the interface. Available providers and models depend on your Harness configuration.

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Install：Install from npm:

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level
~~~

Download the source and run the following from the project directory:

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add .
~~~

Alternatively, install a local plugin archive, replacing the path with the downloaded file:

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./plugin.tgz
~~~

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Install：desktop is an example profile name; replace it with your active profile. Restart the entire Harness application after installation. No build step or development dependencies are needed to install the plugin locally.

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Uninstall：~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level
~~~

Restart Harness to restore its original model picker.

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Usage：1. Click the model button in the composer to open the provider list.
2. Choose a provider to browse its models. Browsing alone does not change the active model.
3. Select a model. On success, the menu closes and the composer reflects the new selection.
4. For a model that supports reasoning, open the reasoning-effort entry on the provider home view and choose an available level.

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Usage：Search from the home view spans all providers. Search within a provider is limited to its models. Clearing the query restores the current view. Provider ordering follows the host: account and official providers come first, followed by the remaining providers in directory order. Unfiltered models retain directory order.

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Keyboard controls：| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| ↑ / ↓ | Move the list highlight without selecting |
| Enter | Open the menu from the model button; enter a highlighted provider or confirm a model / effort; activate a focused button |
| Esc | Clear a nonempty search first; otherwise return to the provider home view, or close the menu from that view |
| Space | Enter text in the search field; does not activate plugin buttons |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Keep the browser's existing focus behavior; no custom plugin action |
@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Keyboard controls：Confirming an IME composition does not submit a selection.

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Compatibility：- DSH runtime: currently declared for 0.2.1-rc.3. Check your version with dsh --version.
- Interface: the Harness Web interface, including the Web interface inside the desktop application.
- Providers: those already configured in Harness and exposed through its model directory.
- Subagent sessions: the model button is disabled in these sessions.

Compatibility with other runtime versions and platforms is not currently declared.

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · FAQ：**Why does the interface look unchanged after installation?**

Restart the entire Harness application and confirm that the plugin was installed in the active profile. Client modules do not hot-reload.

**Do I need to configure providers or API keys again?**

No. The plugin uses the host's existing directory and does not manage credentials.

**Are reasoning-effort preferences permanent?**

@codewei823/dsh-model-picker-2level README · Known limitations：- No plugin settings panel or open / transition animations.
- Screen-reader announcements of highlighted items are incomplete.
- No dedicated reload-all-directories button; loading and caching are managed by the host.
- Host upgrades may affect compatibility. Refer to the declared runtime version.
